#### 读取数据
#### 重新准备时间数据

```{r include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
all_data <- readRDS("./output_data/gcrc/data_analyze_gcrc_score.rds")

# write.csv(all_data, file = "./output_data/km_17points_all_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

pri_data <- all_data
```


```{r collapse=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
str(pri_data)

pri_data <- pri_data %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      death == 0                    ~ 0,
      death == 1 & Cancer == 1      ~ 1,
      death == 1 & is.na(Cancer)    ~ 2,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

pri_data$status <- factor(pri_data$status,
                          levels = c(0, 1, 2))
str(pri_data)

table(pri_data$status)

surv_data <- pri_data[, c("recode", "status", "time", "score_3")]

write.csv(surv_data, file = "./output_data/all_surv_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r collapse=TRUE}
surv_data_time <- read.csv("./output_data/all_surv_data_deathtime.csv")
head(surv_data_time)
```


#### **总人群**

```{r collapse=TRUE}
analysis_data <- surv_data_time %>%
  # 创建事件指示变量：任何原因死亡
  mutate(
    any_death_event = ifelse(status %in% c(1, 2), 1, 0),
    # 确保风险组是因子变量
    risk_group = factor(score_3, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
    # 转换时间单位为年（如果BS2D是天）
    time_years = BS2D / 365.25
  )

# 检查数据
table(analysis_data$risk_group)
table(analysis_data$any_death_event)

# 2. 创建生存对象（所有组一起）
surv_object <- Surv(
  time = analysis_data$time_years,  # 使用年为单位
  event = analysis_data$any_death_event
)

# 3. 拟合Kaplan-Meier模型（按风险组分层）
surv_fit_all <- survfit(
  # surv_object ~ analysis_data$risk_group,
  Surv(time_years, any_death_event) ~ risk_group,
  data = analysis_data
)

# 查看结果摘要
print(surv_fit_all)
surv_fit_all$strata


# 4. 提取特定时间点的生存率
# 3年、5年、10年生存率
summary_survival <- summary(
  surv_fit_all, 
  times = c(3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25)  # 现在是年为单位
)

# 创建结果表格
survival_table <- data.frame(
  Group = summary_survival$strata,
  Time = summary_survival$time,
  N_risk = summary_survival$n.risk,
  N_event = summary_survival$n.event,
  Survival = round(summary_survival$surv, 4),
  Lower_CI = round(summary_survival$lower, 4),
  Upper_CI = round(summary_survival$upper, 4)
)

print(survival_table)

write.csv(survival_table, 
          file = "./output_table/5. gcrc/4. model/gcrc_model/survival/survival_table_by_risk_group.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```



#### 5. Log-rank检验（比较三组）

```{r collapse=TRUE}
logrank_test <- survdiff(
  surv_object ~ analysis_data$risk_group,
  data = analysis_data
)

print(logrank_test)

# 提取p值
logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
cat("\nLog-rank检验 P值:", round(logrank_p, 6), "\n")
```


#### **可视化**使用 ggsurvplot 绘制生存曲线

```{r collapse=TRUE}
pdf(file="./output_plot/model/gcrc_model/survival/survival_curve_by_risk_group15.pdf",
    width=6*1.25,
    height=6)

p <- ggsurvplot(
  surv_fit_all,
  data = analysis_data,
  # 基本设置
  xlab = "Time (years)", ylab = "Survival Probability", 
  # 置信区间
  conf.int = FALSE,
  # conf.int.alpha = 0.2,
  # conf.int.style = "ribbon",
  # 坐标轴设置
  xlim = c(0, 15),  
  ylim = c(0.6, 1.0),  
  break.time.by = 5, 
  # p值和检验
  pval = TRUE, 
  pval.method = TRUE, 
  pval.size=4.5,
  pval.method.size=4.5,
  pval.coord=c(3.5,0.7),
  pval.method.coord=c(0.1,0.7),
  # pval.coord = c(5, 0.05),  
  # 颜色设置
  palette = c("Low"="#2ca02c",
              "Medium"="#ffa040",
              "High"="#d62728"),
  # 风险表
  risk.table = TRUE,
  # 图例
  legend.title = " ",# 图例标题
  legend.labs = c("Low", "Medium", "High"), # 图例标签
  # legend = c(0.85, 0.85),  # 图例位置（右上）
  # 字体大小
  font.main = c(14, "bold"),
  font.x = c(12, "plain"),
  font.y = c(12, "plain"),
  font.legend = c(11, "plain"),
  font.risk.table = c(10, "plain"),
  # 其他
  ggtheme = theme_bw()
)

print(p)

dev.off()

# 保存图形
# ggsave("./output_plot/model/gcrc_model/survival/survival_curve_by_risk_group.pdf", 
#        print(p), 
#        width = 6*1.25, 
#        height = 6)
```



#### 7. Cox回归分析（定量比较）

```{r collapse=TRUE}
cox_model <- coxph(
  surv_object ~ analysis_data$risk_group,
  data = analysis_data
)

summary(cox_model)

# 提取风险比
cox_results <- broom::tidy(cox_model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
print(cox_results)

write.csv(cox_results, 
          file = "./output_table/5. gcrc/4. model/gcrc_model/survival/survival_curve_by_risk_group.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
